name: CrewAI-Studio (Unofficial CrewAI GUI) - Hacker News
snippet: CrewAI-Studio (Unofficial CrewAI GUI) | Hacker News Hey everyone! I've been working on a project called CrewAI Studio, a user-friendly, multi-platform GUI designed to manage and run CrewAI agents and tasks with ease. It's built with Streamlit, supports Conda and virtual environments, and requires no coding skills. Features: Multi-platform support (Windows, Linux, MacOS) Custom tools and API support Background crew execution Easy installer OpenAI, Groq or LM Studio (for local models) crewAI-tools bugfix: RagTool based tools now handle post-creation passed parameters correctly #<49> I'd love to get your feedback on what should be added or modified. Check it out on https://github.com/strnad/CrewAI-Studio
